item.title: Version 3.3.0
item.description:
🚀 Release Notes: Context Collector v3.3.0
This major update represents a complete transformation of the application, featuring a rebuilt UI, enhanced performance, and powerful new features for managing code context.
🌟 Major Highlights
🆕 Multi-Tab Support & Session Persistence * Multiple Workspaces: You can now open multiple collection sessions in tabs, allowing you to work on different parts of a project or different projects simultaneously. * Auto-Save & Persistence: All sessions are now automatically saved and persisted across app restarts. Never lose your carefully curated file lists or virtual edits again. * Keyboard Navigation: Switch between tabs and perform actions quickly with a comprehensive set of new keyboard shortcuts.
📝 Enhanced Content Management (Header & Footer) * Flexible Templates: Replaced the single "Prompt" file with dedicated Header and Footer virtual files. * Verbatim Insertion: Content in Header and Footer files is inserted exactly as-is at the start and end of your markdown, perfect for custom instructions or formatting requirements.
🌲 Rebuilt Virtual Tree * Native-Feel Directory Tree: Integrated a high-performance directory tree (via flutter_directory_tree) for navigating large codebases. * Advanced Selection: Improved logic for selecting/deselecting folders and nested files with real-time state synchronization. * Floating Specials: Header and Footer files are pinned to the top and bottom of the tree for instant access.
💻 Professional Editor Experience * Monaco Integration: Upgraded to the latest Monaco Editor for a true IDE-like experience (IntelliSense, robust syntax highlighting). * Workspace Completion: A new completion provider understands your workspace context to help you write prompts and headers faster. * Improved Focus Handling: Smoother transitions between the file list and the editor, with focus restoration after dialogs.
📊 Accurate Token Calculation * Isolate-Based Counting: Token calculation now runs in a background thread (Isolate), ensuring the UI remains perfectly fluid even when processing massive collections. * Model Selection: Support for different tokenization models to match your target AI (GPT-4, Claude, etc.).
🛠 Improvements & Refinements * UI Redesign: A modern, polished layout featuring a resizable sidebar, better theme support (Dark/Light/System), and enhanced visual feedback. * Drop Handler: More robust drag-and-drop support for files and folders directly from Finder/Explorer. * Performance: Drastic reduction in binary size by optimizing internal assets and cleaning up legacy dependencies. * Windows Store Prep: Updated Windows resources and MSIX build workflows for easier distribution. * Pandoc Support: Added specialized documentation and support for Pandoc-compatible markdown generation.
📦 Maintenance * Version: 3.3.0+8 * Privacy Policy: Added a comprehensive privacy policy document. * Dependency Audit: Significant cleanup of unused packages and updates to core libraries (flutter_riverpod, flutter_monaco, etc.).

item.description:
### A Major Overhaul for a Better Experience
**A New User Interface:** * The application has been completely redesigned for a cleaner, more modern, and intuitive user experience.
**Smarter File Management:** * Files are now organized in a structured **File Tree** instead of a flat list, making it easier to navigate complex projects.
**Enhanced Code Editor:** * Enhanced separator between the virtual tree and the Monaco. * The info bar below the editor has been updated and now includes a **Token Counter** to estimate context size. * The main settings dialog is now organized more organized. * File filtering has been simplified to a **blacklist** system for excluding specific files or extensions. * You can import files/directories through their paths.
**Improved Performance and Reliability:** * The application's core has been re-architected to be faster, more stable, and more efficient.

item.title: Version release-2.2.0
item.description:
## Version 2.2.0 - The Simplification Update!
This release introduces a major simplification of the file tree logic and a series of UX improvements to make starting a new session faster and more intuitive. We've focused on reducing complexity and refining the core user workflows.
### ✨ New Features & Enhancements
* **New "Start with a New File" Workflow**: The home screen now features a "Start with a New File" button. Instead of just showing an empty screen, it immediately kicks off the process for creating your first virtual file, letting you name it and add content right away. * **Centralized Actions**: We've added a new toolbar at the top of the file tree with icons for: * 🔄 **Refresh Content**: Reloads all original files from the disk, discarding any in-app edits. * 📄 **New Virtual File**: The only way to create new virtual files now, keeping the UI clean and simple. * **Reliable "Copy Content"**: The copy button is now smarter! It pulls the absolute latest text directly from the editor, ensuring even your most recent keystrokes are included. * **"Paste Paths" on Folders**: You can now right-click any folder in the tree and select "Paste Paths..." to add more files.
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* **macOS Keyboard Fix**: Fixed a critical bug on macOS where the keyboard would stop working in the editor after closing a dialog (like Settings or Paste Paths). Your keyboard focus will now be correctly restored. * **Simplified Tree View**: All files and folders (both real and virtual) now live under a single, collapsible `tree/` root directory. This makes the file structure much easier to understand and manage.
### 🧹 Housekeeping
* **Removed Virtual Folders**: To streamline the experience for quick notes and scratchpads, we've removed the ability to create empty virtual folders. All virtual files now live at the top level. * Updated various dependencies to their latest versions for improved performance and security.
